pages.title: Conservation and admissibility
pages.text:
Conservation and admissibility
A step is accepted only when the storage equations and all valve inequalities hold together.
Constant-compliance relaxation supplies an exact reference; switching and changing
compliance require their own error analysis.
Computational Cardiology Notes 19 / 19
